description: A line per series over shared labels. Screen readers get a text summary per series, and `showTable` adds a data table.

props.name: series
props.description: The series; they share the labels.

props.name: labels
props.description: The label of each position along the horizontal axis.

props.name: title
props.description: A heading above the chart, also its spoken name.

props.name: summaryTemplate
props.description: What a screen reader hears for each series; `{name}`, `{count}`, `{first}`, `{last}`, `{min}` and `{max}` are replaced.

props.name: showTable
props.description: Whether a table of the values is shown below the chart.
